messages:
alex: Heads-up — PR #21499 is stuck in the merge-queue due to a mixed approvals check. It has platform + runtime approvals but security scanner flagged a potential secret in docs build artifacts (likely false positive). Infra also wants a quick canary run. Can runtime/security/infra triage async? PR: https://git.redwood.ai/redwood/repo/pull/21499 :link:

maria-platform: I'm looking. The merge-queue shows `blocking: security-review` and `ci/canary` pending. If runtime confirms kernel change is safe we can prioritize. @sam-runtime can you confirm the kernel ABI change surface? :eyes:

sam-runtime: On it. Quick note — this PR lands a small change to the batching kernel where we change the eviction header ordering. I'm worried about a perf regress on short-seq paths. I'll run a short local perf + smoke and post results here.

deploy-bot: CI: canary pipeline queued for PR #21499 — estimated 12m.

alex: Thanks. If security confirms the scanner false-positive we can remove the `blocking: security-review` label and let merge-queue proceed. If infra needs a manual canary we'll hold for their sign-off. If anyone can pick the final merge window (today afternoon PST) please say so.

paul-infra: I can run the manual canary if needed. Queue me when the canary pipeline finishes. Also please add label `triage:merge-blocker` so I find it quickly.

tia-security: I'll re-run the secret-scan against the built artifacts and paste the analyzer output. Quick ask: can you upload the reproducer artifact (docs tarball) or give me the exact path? If it's a false positive I can clear the blocker in ~15-20m.

sam-runtime: Quick paste of local smoke logs:
```
batch_kernel: init ok
evict header reorder applied
latency p50 baseline 12.4ms -> new 12.6ms (+1.6%)
no crashes observed
```
Seems fine for short smoke. I'll attach a perf histogram in ~10m.

maria-platform: Thanks @sam-runtime and @tia-security. I'll plan to remove the security block when tia confirms. @paul-infra ping me when manual canary is ready and I'll bump merge priority.

tia-security: Scanner re-run: flagged string "example-key-REDACTED" in docs HTML at path `/build/docs/embedding_client.html`. Looks like an example token left in an example snippet. If the PR authors can scrub that or we patch docs build to redact, we can clear. Quick mitigation: mark the finding as test-only and block removal not allowed — need an author change.

alex: Ok — @pr-author (cc @sam-runtime) can we replace the example token with `[REDACTED_EXAMPLE]`? that'll be the fastest unblock.

pr-author: Pushed fix — replaced the token with `[REDACTED_EXAMPLE]` and rebuilt docs. Link to updated artefact: https://ci.redwood.ai/artifacts/21499/docs.tar.gz

tia-security: Re-scanned updated artifact. No secrets found. Clearing `security-review` blocker now. :white_check_mark:

paul-infra: Canary pipeline passed (2/2 canaries). I'll give manual sign-off in 5 and we can merge in the 3pm PST window. :rocket:

maria-platform: I'll remove `triage:merge-blocker` label and schedule merge for 15:00 PST. If anything else pops up ping this thread.

alex: Amazing — thanks everyone for fast async triage. I'll hold the merge queue until 3pm PST and then merge. If anybody wants to change scheduling DM me. :tada:
